text:
pagerbot: PAGER — Suspicious auth traffic detected from edge-proxy-usw2. Spike of 401/403s to /v1/generate and /v1/chat. Source IP cluster: 54.38.12.99/29. Header note: X-Debug-Session present in several requests. AlertID: IR-2026-041.

maria: ack, I'm oncall. adding context: surge started ~12:03 UTC, ~1.2k reqs in 2m, ~18% 401s. @andrew please join. any sign of token leakage?

andrew: joining. can you paste one sanitized sample header/payload? also are any internal svc tokens showing unexpected use?

maria: pasted log snippet: ```
ts=2026-03-18T12:03:14Z level=warn path=/v1/generate status=401 src=54.38.12.101 hdrs={Authorization: Bearer ***snip***, X-Debug-Session: debug-42, User-Agent: curl/7.82.0} resp="unauthorized"
```

andrew: saw X-Debug-Session in logs earlier when debug logging accidentally enabled for indexer. possible that debug archive included session fragments. need quick scope: which buckets/forwarders received debug logs in last 24h?

ops_lead: I'm rate-limiting 54.38.12.99/29 at the edge and adding firewall deny for the block. Pushing WAF rule now (rule id wf-3379).

maria: good. I'm starting a targeted token rotation: rotate service account inference-bridge-svc, revoke tokens issued in last 12h. Running: `./ops/rotate-svc-token --svc inference-bridge --env prod --since 12h --force`

andrew: will run a KMS key rewrap for the svc principal and update Dedicated node secrets. ETA 15m. Also dumping access logs to secure bucket for forensic timeline: `s3://sec-artifacts/IR-2026-041/` (write-only for sec-oncall + legal).

maria: customer impact check: initial sampling shows ~7 customers saw 401s (retries normalized), one partner (acme-corp) reported increased errors on inference endpoint ~12:05-12:08 UTC. We'll prepare a hold message but not public outage yet.

andrew: forensic note: evidence indicates a debug-logger forwarder (staging->prod misconfig) may have forwarded truncated auth headers to an internal buffer that was picked up by an external probe. We're treating as potential leak of partial tokens.

legal: preserve all artifacts and DM secure details. If confirmed exposure of customer tokens we need to onboard Data Protection and draft notification template.

ops_lead: checklist update: WAF block in place, IPs blackholed, ingress rate cap lowered from 1000r/s to 200r/s for affected routes, health checks green.

maria: mitigation plan (short): 1) block IPs and rate-limit (done), 2) rotate inference-bridge-svc tokens (in progress), 3) rewrap KMS key + update secrets (in progress), 4) run quick grep for 'X-Debug-Session' across recent log exports and S3 forwards, 5) preserve artifacts for legal.

sophie: thanks for the handoff — I'll take after-hours in 2h. please post a final summary with rotated token IDs and updated secret versions.

andrew: posted rotated token IDs to secure channel (redacted here). Keys rewrapped, Dedicated secrets updated on nodes, and we pushed new env var pull on Dedicated. Monitoring for auth failures now.

maria: action items logged in pagerduty note IR-2026-041: rotate tokens, update Dedicated secrets, run log grep, contact acme-corp support (cc: solutions). If no further 401s in 30m we'll de-escalate.

legal: acknowledged. keep chain-of-custody notes in s3://sec-artifacts/IR-2026-041/chain_of_custody.txt.

maria: thanks team. handing to @sophie in 2h for watch. leaving this thread open for additional evidence. :white_check_mark:
